Vector database: indexes, namespaces, vectors and documents, plus hosted embedding and rerank.

## API key

1. Open [app.pinecone.io](https://app.pinecone.io/organizations/-/projects/-/keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the project's API keys page and the host of the index the app uses.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add pinecone
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  pinecone: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Pinecone's [API](https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show pinecone` shows the key as set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Pinecone).
